errors.root_cause: a 16x16 nn.Linear is applied to a 96-wide input: the projection's in_features was taken from lora_rank (16) instead of the real input width (96; state_dim 32, W_in maps 96->32). Every forward raised; the loop caught it per agent per epoch instead of aborting.

why_30_gib.cause: each checkpoint embeds the entire accumulated errors list inside data.pkl, so the file grows with the log, not with learning

method.errata: The first pass reported 'numpy cp314 binaries under py3.11/py3.12' as the reason torch could not import. That was FALSE. The system interpreters are healthy (py3.11: numpy 1.26.4 + torch 2.5.1; py3.12: numpy 2.0.2 + torch 2.9.1 + rdkit 2026.03.6). The cp314 numpy is the TOOL environment's: execute_code runs Python 3.14.9 and exports a PYTHONPATH pointing at its own venv, which child interpreters inherit. Fix is on the caller (PYTHONPATH cleared / -E), not in either interpreter.
method.method_1_stub_unpickler: decoded the torch.save zip directly; recovers keys/shapes/dtypes from _rebuild_tensor_v2 args, never materialises tensor data
